title: Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval Augmented Generation through Internal Representation Learning
authors: Ruoshuang Du; Xin Sun; Qiang Liu; Bowen Song; Zhongqi Chen; Weiqiang Wang; Liang Wang
why_relevant: Proposes adaptive retrieval for multimodal RAG that uses internal representations to decide when retrieved evidence is harmful vs helpful, directly addressing noisy/misleading retrieval and when-to-retrieve calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on multimodal VQA with reverse image retrieval, narrower than text RAG.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
